profile.summary: A company that provides training and consulting on critical incident response, disaster preparation and emergency response. It serves K-12 schools, colleges, healthcare facilities, law enforcement, workplaces and affordable housing organizations. Its offerings include in-person and virtual trainings, on-demand courses, tabletop exercises and emergency guidebooks.
